thread:
marie: Heads-up: deploying routing-service v4 to staging + canary tomorrow 2026-03-18 16:00 PT. Canary = 5% traffic initially. Rollout window 45m. Need obs handoff + smoke run. @alex you on deploy?

alex: On it, I can kick the rollout at :00. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results here. Who's touching dashboards/traces?

jyoti: I got dashboards. I'll update per-route p90/p95 panels, and set traces sampling to 5% for canary. Will add a temporary annotation for the canary start. ETA ~10m.

marie: Thanks. Quick smoke checklist (run after canary step):
```
# smoke checklist
1) curl basic gen endpoint w/ auth and short prompt
2) check token count + response correctness
3) check KV cache hit-rate via redis: 'redis-cli HGET cache stats'
4) confirm p95 latency < 500ms (staging)
5) confirm no new 5xx in last 1m
```
Also verify traces show correct service span names (routing-service -> model-proxy).

sam: I'll watch alerts. Plan: silence the noisy latency alert for the canary slice and bump the latency alert threshold +20% for 10m to avoid noisy pages. If error rate spikes >0.5% sustained for 3m we escalate/rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout: routing-service v4 -> canary 5% (pods: 3)

alex: Deploy started. pods 3/3 ready in canary. Running basic curl smoke:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"quick test"}' | jq .
```

marie: Results so far: response time 210ms, tokens returned as expected, trace id=abc123. @jyoti can you pin a trace filter for abc123 in the new dashboard?

jyoti: Done — pushed dashboard v2.3 and added annotation "v4-canary" at current ts. Adjusted trace sampling and added a span heatmap. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/routing-service (internal).

sam: Alerts suppressed for canary slice. I'll monitor error-rate and tail latency. I'll escalate immediately if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 jump > 30%.

alex: No errors in logs. Rolling to 20% in 10m if metrics stay green. Also pinging owners for the metrics rename PR: @marco @leen please ACK the PR that fixes metric names for the new span.

marco: ACK, will review in ~15m.

leen: Reviewed and LGTM, minor docs nit.

marie: Reminder: rollback policy = immediate rollback to v3 + notify #eng-oncall if we see sustained 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 30% increase. Keep notes here so we can post a small post-deploy blip if anything odd.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 5% step complete ✅. Scheduling next step to 20% in 10m.

sam: Smoke results: all checks pass except slight tail latency increase (~+8% p95). Watching for escalation.

alex: Thanks all. I'll post final SHA and canary end time after the 20% step. Leave any follow-ups here — I'll ping if we need a rollback.
